raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 12 arrived with lowercase status values ('posted'/'reversed') and '$'-prefixed amounts. The silver filter `status = 'POSTED'` is case-sensitive, so every batch-12 row was dropped. The fix normalizes status case and strips the '$' from amount before the DECIMAL cast.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(replace(trim(amount), '$', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE upper(trim(status)) = 'POSTED'"}}
